directive: JAYT-134H — CANONICAL STATE, IDEMPOTENCY & HASH-TRUTH REPAIR
executive_finding: Independent audit by CEO identified three critical governance blocking errors following JAYT-134G execution:

governance_errors.description: PROJECT_MEMORY.md contained two contradictory 'current' status headers: the top header retained 'GOVERNANCE_AND_PROVENANCE_AUDIT_FAILED', while the 134G body recorded 'GOVERNANCE_RECOVERY_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT'.
governance_errors.remediation: Upgraded applyProjectMemoryTransaction067 to maintain a single canonical Current Truth Header at the top of PROJECT_MEMORY.md recording 'SAFE_UI_CONTAINMENT_PROVISIONAL — GOVERNANCE_RECOVERY_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT'.

governance_errors.description: Review Pack 134G hardcoded a previous JS hash ('ae4f...a37eef...') instead of dynamically computing the actual physical file hash ('ae4f3376524650a36d623ff79d47b387ae57eb5121f9bfb7c875fddcd3bbac35').
governance_errors.remediation: All hashes across review packs and audit scripts must be dynamically computed at report generation time from on-disk buffers.

governance_errors.description: apply_memory_transaction_134g.js lacked idempotency guardrails. When re-executed during CEO independent audit, it created a second transaction receipt and altered the memory hash rather than recognizing the work order as already applied.
governance_errors.remediation: Added native idempotency to applyProjectMemoryTransaction067: re-executing an already applied work order returns ALREADY_APPLIED and guarantees byte-for-byte memory hash invariance with zero new receipts.
